title: Kyrios
html_source: Kyrios or kurios (Ancient Greek: κύριος) is a Greek word which is usually translated as “lord” or “master”. In religious usage, it is sometimes translated as God. It is used in the Septuagint translation of the Hebrew Bible and the Greek New Testament
